lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: Hi, this is Robin with Fairview Bank, you'd asked about opening a basic checking account.

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: Yes, just the free basic one please.

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: Actually, I went ahead and enrolled you in our Premium Checking tier instead since it has more features.

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: Oh, I didn't ask for that, does it cost anything?

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: There's a $12 monthly fee, but you'll get better perks.

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: I'd rather just have the basic account.

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: No problem, I'll switch it back.
